definition: Eurotra was a machine translation project established and funded by the European Commission from 1978 until 1992.
details: Eurotra was a machine translation project established and funded by the European Commission from 1978 until 1992.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Eurotra — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
